starts without this one's messages.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def gf2_solve(X,y):
 M=np.concatenate([X%2,(y%2)[:,None]],axis=1).astype(np.uint8); m,n=M.shape; row=0;piv=[]
 for col in range(n-1):
  inds=np.where(M[row:,col])[0]
  if len(inds)==0: continue
  q=row+inds[0];M[[row,q]]=M[[q,row]]
  for r in range(m):
   if r!=row and M[r,col]: M[r]^=M[row]
  piv.append(col);row+=1
  if row==m:break
 if np.any((M[:, :-1].sum(axis=1)==0)&(M[:,-1]==1)):return None,piv
 x=np.zeros(n-1,dtype=np.uint8)
 for r,c in enumerate(piv): x[c]=M[r,-1]
 return x,piv
for rad in [1,2,3]:
 offsets=[(dy,dx) for dy in range(-rad,rad+1) for dx in range(-rad,rad+1)]
 XX=[]; yy=[]
 for A,B in pairs:
  XX.append(np.stack([shifted(A,dy,dx).ravel() for dy,dx in offsets]+[np.ones(A.size,dtype=int)],axis=1));yy.extend(B.ravel())
 x,p=gf2_solve(np.concatenate(XX),np.array(yy))
 print('rad',rad,'solution?',x is not None,'rank',len(p),'weight',x.sum() if x is not None else None,'coeffs',[(offsets[k],int(v)) for k,v in enumerate(x[:-1]) if v] if x is not None else None,'bias',int(x[-1]) if x is not None else None)

def gf2_solve(X,y):
 M=np.concatenate([X%2,(y%2)[:,None]],axis=1).astype(np.uint8);m,n=M.shape;row=0;piv=[]
 for col in range(n-1):
  inds=np.where(M[row:,col])[0]
  if not len(inds):continue
  q=row+inds[0];M[[row,q]]=M[[q,row]]
  for r in range(m):
   if r!=row and M[r,col]:M[r]^=M[row]
  piv.append(col);row+=1
  if row==m:break
 if np.any((M[:,:-1].sum(1)==0)&(M[:,-1]==1)): return None,piv
 x=np.zeros(n-1,dtype=np.uint8)
 for r,c in enumerate(piv):x[c]=M[r,-1]
 return x,piv
for rad in [1,2,3]:
 offs=[(dy,dx) for dy in range(-rad,rad+1) for dx in range(-rad,rad+1)]
 X=[];y=[]
 for A,B in pairs:

 x,p=gf2_solve(np.concatenate(X),np.array(y))
 print(rad, x is not None, len(p), (x.sum() if x is not None else None))
